## GET /v1/aliases

Lists this caller's aliases by name, each with the template it names now.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | No | How many to return, up to 200. Default 50. |
| `cursor` | query | No | `nextCursor` from the page before. |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | A page of aliases | [`AliasList`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#aliaslist) |
| 501 | RUSTICDOC_STORE is not set | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 503 | The store cannot be reached | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## GET /v1/aliases/{name}

An alias, the template it names now, and its history: every version since
it was last deleted, oldest first.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | Yes | The alias |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The alias and its versions | [`AliasHistorySchema`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#aliashistoryschema) |
| 404 | This caller has no such alias | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | RUSTICDOC_STORE is not set | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 503 | The store cannot be reached | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## PUT /v1/aliases/{name}

Points an alias at a template. A new alias starts at version 1; pointing an
existing one elsewhere adds a version, and the earlier ones stay. Every
replica sees the change at once.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | Yes | The alias, such as `invoice` |

### Request

`application/json`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string | Yes | The template the alias names from now on: an id, or another alias. |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | A new version of an alias | [`AliasSchema`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#aliasschema) |
| 201 | A new alias | [`AliasSchema`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#aliasschema) |
| 400 | Not a usable name, or no template named | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 403 | Too many aliases, or versions of this one | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 404 | This caller has no such template | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | RUSTICDOC_STORE is not set | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 503 | The store cannot be reached | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## DELETE /v1/aliases/{name}

Deletes an alias and its history. The templates it named stay. Setting it
again starts at version 1.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | Yes | The alias |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 204 | Deleted |  |
| 404 | This caller has no such alias | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | RUSTICDOC_STORE is not set | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 503 | The store cannot be reached | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## POST /v1/templates

Stores a template and returns its id. Syntax is checked now, without data, so a
broken template is refused here rather than at its first render. The content
never changes: to change a template, store the new one and use its id.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Request

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `template` | file | Yes | The template: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, PDF or a text format. |
| `name` | string | No | A name for it, in place of the file's. The extension stays the file's. |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | Stored | [`TemplateSchema`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#templateschema) |
| 400 | Not a template format | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 403 | This caller's quota is used up | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 413 | Too large | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 422 | The template has syntax errors | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | RUSTICDOC_STORE is not set | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 503 | The store cannot be reached | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## POST /v1/templates/{id}/preview

Renders a stored template with sample data and draws one page as a PNG,
for checking a template without opening the document. Office templates
convert with LibreOffice, HTML with its HTML engine, and PDF forms are filled;
poppler's `pdftoppm` draws the page. The page count is in `X-Page-Count`.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | Yes | The template's id, or an alias as `name` or `name@version` |

### Request

`application/json`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ctx` | JSON | No | Visible as `ctx`. |
| `data` | JSON | No | Sample data the template sees as its root. |
| `dpi` | integer | No | Draw at this resolution, from 18 to 300, as large as the page is. An image may not pass 4000 pixels on a side. |
| `htmlEngine` | string | No | What turns HTML into PDF: `fulgur` (default) or `libreoffice`. |
| `page` | integer | No | The page to draw, from 1. Default 1. |
| `width` | integer | No | The image's width in pixels, from 16 to 2000; the height follows the page. Default 800. Send this or `dpi`. |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The page as a PNG | File |
| 400 | The request is wrong, or the page does not exist | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 404 | This caller has no such template | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 422 | The template failed to render | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | RUSTICDOC_STORE is not set | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 503 | pdftoppm or LibreOffice is unavailable, or the request timed out | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## GET /v1/templates/{id}/variables

Lists the data a template reads: each path, which paths are arrays it loops
over, and the fields it reads from their items, with a skeleton of data.
Read from the template's tags, so a path built at render time, such as
`row[column]`, is listed only as far as it is written.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | Yes | The template's id, or an alias as `name` or `name@version` |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | What the template reads | [`TemplateVariables`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#templatevariables) |
| 404 | This caller has no such template | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 422 | The template has syntax errors | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | RUSTICDOC_STORE is not set | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 503 | The store cannot be reached | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
